request.utterance: 이 벡터 DB 노트들 정리해서 뭔가 만들어줘.

transformation.basis: "정리해서" (organize/clean up) is genuinely ambiguous between compress (shorten the existing notes) and synthesize (combine them into a new argument) — the two read very differently and change what "만들어줘" (make something) is allowed to add.

content_type.basis: "뭔가 만들어줘" (make something) names no content type; research vs. note carries a materially different evidence burden (research.json requires >=3 sources and a contradicting-role source; note.json does not).

audience.basis: the source notes are technical vector-DB material with no stated destination audience; practitioner is the safe default for this repo's usual reader and asking about it would not change much given the source material itself is already practitioner-level.

surface.basis: no destination was named; suengj-com is the default publication surface (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §8).

asked.question: 이 노트들을 어떻게 다룰까요? 있는 내용을 더 짧게 정리(compress)할까요, 아니면 여러 노트를 하나의 새로운 관점으로 종합(synthesize)할까요?
결과물은 짧은 노트(note)가 좋을까요, 아니면 근거를 갖춘 research 글이 좋을까요?
